headline: Increase of inflation levels in US
summary: On June 10, 2026, President Trump seemed to endorse figures showing inflation had climbed above 4%. He said prices would drop once the war with Iran ends.
why: Inflation levels above target shape Federal Reserve policy expectations, which feed into Treasury yields, the dollar and equity valuations.

why_moved: Reported inflation above 4% raises questions about how quickly the Federal Reserve can ease policy, which weighs on rate-sensitive assets.
